description: The agent must: (1) Read references/sop.md and the SKILL.md decision table to correctly identify the scenario as '22=True, 5900=False → Mac Screen Sharing/VNC *service* issue, NOT an ACL issue'. (2) Produce recovery_runbook.md that includes the 5 Mac-side diagnostic commands (tailscale status, tailscale ip -4, systemsetup -getremotelogin, netstat grep 5900, nc test), the exact restart command 'sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.apple.screensharing' (proprietary trap — general agents may guess a different launchctl syntax or service name), and the skill's specific layered priority: SSH fallback first, AnyDesk as *primary* GUI fallback, VNC as *secondary* GUI fallback (not the naive ordering). (3) Read references/acl-template.md and produce tailscale_acl.json with exactly: 'acls' array with action=accept, src=tag:windows-client, dst=[tag:mac-host:22, tag:mac-host:5900], and tagOwners mapping both tags to autogroup:admin. An agent relying on general knowledge will get the ACL structure wrong (using raw IPs instead of tags, omitting tagOwners, or mis-ordering the layered stack).
